All four paused() reads return false. Native mint authority remains separately scoped to Etherlink.

oracleRisk.summary: USDSM native issuance and redemption exchange USD at fixed par rather than a variable NAV or collateral-liquidation price. Native mint is role-gated and not price-oracle-gated; administrative mint authority and financial reserve assurance remain separate risks.

branchApplicability.rationale: Terms sections 4, 8 and 9 define fixed-par USDSM claims without yield or NAV appreciation. The verified native USDSM.mint function checks MINTER_ROLE and request-ID reuse, with no external-price read, borrower debt position or collateral liquidation.

routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Verified native adapter burns the dust-adjusted debit and credits the authenticated message amount. sharedDecimals=6 and decimalConversionRate=1000000000000 on all four chains; uint64 shared-amount overflow reverts. These encoding bounds are not reserve-gated economic caps. Token EOAs and role/proxy administrators retain separately disclosed mint bypass powers.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: Pinned official adapters: Etherlink 0xe7f117f87fa650350c3e363ca2c644951d273d1f; Ethereum 0x0afa4be6fa5ebaf5ffee3ab9f88eaa3e16c37ade; Base and Arbitrum 0x1053baf5964b82859f6aa140ed2c02f2975075eb. All twelve directed peers match these chain-qualified adapters. Native verified lzReceive accepts only its immutable endpoint and the configured peer; lzReceiveSimulate is self-only and lzReceiveAndRevert always reverts.
routeChecks.rateLimits: Verified native adapter and inherited OFT code implement no rolling daily or per-route economic rate limiter. All four preCrime and msgInspector reads are zero. No extra limiter is inferred from uint64 encoding, quoted totalSupply or enforced execution gas.
routeChecks.signingModel: All twenty-four effective send/receive ULN configurations require two DVNs, with zero optional DVNs and zero optional threshold. The issuer identifies these as LZ Labs and Horizen; independent operator/key-control assurance is not established. All twelve receive libraries are explicit, send defaults are false, and receiveLibraryTimeout returns zero address and expiry for every path.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: All four adapter owner() and Endpoint.delegates(adapter) reads return issuer EOA 0x1bb0b2666edd827f74b558136fdbe69e4ecec5fd; pendingOwner is zero. Verified native onlyOwner methods can change peer/delegate/inspector/PreCrime without a timelock; delegate configures endpoint libraries and ULNs. Token administrators can pause, blacklist, grant mint roles or upgrade through the separately recorded ProxyAdmins. Fresh token paused() is false on all four chains.
